No. 2447/04 - MONDAY, JULY 28, 2025
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

Ref. No.: RAT/LAN/10/FI/12. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land/servitude intended to be acquired : Two allotments of land in total extent of about 0.1063 hectares, depicted as Lot No. 01 and 02 in the Cadastral Map No. 521004/07/09 dated 21/03/2025, prepared by the Surveyor General situated at Grama Niladhari Division No. 541, Mount Lavinia within the Municipal Council limits of Dehiwala - Mount Lavinia, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ratmalana, in Colombo District, Western Province and bounded as follows :

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Galkissa Watta, Assessment No. 37/2, Sri Dharmapala Mawatha; Description : Home Garden; Claimant: For acquisition to the government; Original Claimant: C. D. Kasi Chetty, No. 10A, Elite C Place, Colombo 08; Extent: 0.0532 Hectare.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Galkissa Watta, Assessment No. 37/2, Sri Dharmapala Mawatha; Description : Home Garden; Claimant: For acquisition to the government; Original Claimant: N. Y. Kasi Chetty, No. 11, Abeywickrama Mawatha, Mount Lavinia; Extent: 0.0531 Hectare.

All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me on 17th September, 2025 at 10.30 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat situated at No. 175, Galle road, Ratmalana.

Further, you are hereby requested to notify me in writing in duplicate before 03rd September, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Deeds and other documents should be produced at the inquiry.
M. M. K. Dilrukshi Walpola, Divisional Secretary, Ratmalana. At the Divisional Secretariat, Ratmalana, 22nd July, 2025. EOG 07 - 0324
